**Class** in the `Latiprimere.Rendering.Pdfium` namespace, from the [Latiprimere.Rendering.Pdfium](/docs/reference/#latiprimererenderingpdfium) package. Implements [IPdfRasterizer](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/ipdfrasterizer/).

```csharp
public sealed class PdfiumRasterizer : IPdfRasterizer
```

Rasterises PDF documents with PDFium.

PDFium is not thread-safe, so all PDFium work in the process is serialised: documents can be used from several threads, but only one renders at a time.

PDFium parses each PDF in native code. For PDFs from anyone, limit what one can take with [PdfiumOptions](/docs/reference/latiprimere-rendering-pdfium/pdfiumoptions/): its size, and how long a page may render for.

**Exceptions**

## Methods

### Open

```csharp
public IRasterDocument Open(Stream content, PdfOpenOptions? options = null)
```

Opens a PDF document for rasterising.

**Parameters**

- `content`: A readable stream containing the PDF, read from its current position to the end. The caller keeps ownership of the stream; the document does not need it after this call returns.
- `options`: How to open it, such as its password; `null` for [PdfOpenOptions.Default](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/pdfopenoptions/#default).

**Returns**

The opened document. Dispose it when finished.

**Exceptions**

- [ArgumentNullException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentnullexception): `content` is `null`.
- [PrintException](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printexception/): The document is longer than [PdfiumOptions.MaxDocumentBytes](/docs/reference/latiprimere-rendering-pdfium/pdfiumoptions/#maxdocumentbytes), or PDFium can't open it.
